subject: world_language
concept: Understanding a short simple story or dialogue read or spoken in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'understand short simple texts' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while hearing/reading a short target-language story
exercise.abstract: Student answers simple comprehension questions about the story in the target language or their native language

misconception_flags: relies on picture guessing rather than actually comprehending the target-language text

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
